{{Recipe summary
| Servings = 4–6
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]]

'''Cinnamon croûtons''' are a sweet variation on the classic salad [[Cookbook:Crouton|croûton]], which can be used to enhance a fruit salad. Alternately, these croûtons make a good addition to pumpkin, sweet potato, or carrot soups.

==Ingredients==
*4 slices day-old [[cookbook:Baguette|French bread]], [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnut]] [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]]
*4 tablespoons white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|ground cinnamon]]

==Procedure==
# Combine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl, and set aside.
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (~180°C).
# Heat the walnut oil in a frying pan. Add the bread cubes, then fry them, tossing to coat with oil.
# Spread the bread cubes on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 8 minutes or until crispy and dry. 
# Allow to cool well before handling, as the sugar will make these croûtons easier to brown, and thus hotter to handle initially.
